cards.title: Clean Core Architecture — Phase 1
cards.subtitle: AIS ABAP & CDS AI Debug Studio

description.plain:
Card 1 — Use case & problem

Industry / user persona — SAP S/4HANA & ECC Development and Support Teams | ABAP Developers, CDS Developers, Basis and Functional Support Consultants

Problem (3 bullets) — • ST22 short dumps are cryptic; developers dig through runtime logs just to understand a crash.
• Pinpointing the failing line and root cause depends on scarce, experienced ABAP expertise.
• CDS activation errors, package creation and transports force constant switching between SAP GUI and ADT.

What we solve (max 2 lines) — Reads ST22 dumps and CDS errors through SAP ADT, explains them in plain English, and pushes AI-generated fixes live only after developer confirmation.

Tech stack tags (comma list) — SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry, Python, FastAPI, Uvicorn, MCP, SAP Joule, LLM, SAP ADT, SAP Cloud Connector

SAP touchpoints (modules, tables, APIs) — ST22 runtime dumps; ABAP programs; CDS DDL views (DDIC); development packages (DevClass); transport requests (SE09/SE10); ADT REST APIs under /sap/bc/adt/*. Demo objects: ZTEST_CALCULATOR, ZCDS_BOM_COMP (MAST, STPO, STKO), ZI_SalesOrder_HeaderItem (VBAK, VBAP).

Image (optional) + caption — abapdebug_c1_1.png — ST22 workbench listing system crash dumps with exception, program and timestamp.

Bot lines — "Every SAP developer knows the pain of a short dump. Here, crashes appear as a clear list, ready for instant AI diagnosis."

cards.title: Key features
cards.subtitle: AIS ABAP & CDS AI Debug Studio

description.plain:
Key features

ABAP Code Explorer | Fetches active ABAP source from SAP via ADT with an AI logic summary, plus copy and .abap download. | abapdebug_c4_1.png

Generative CDS View Builder | Turns a plain-English prompt into CDS DDL with joins and associations, optional Fiori OData exposure and live activation. | abapdebug_c4_2.png

CDS Diagnostics & Auto-Repair | Diagnoses activation failures such as a missing key or bare join and returns repaired DDL ready to push to SAP. | abapdebug_c4_3.png

• "Three tools stand out: read any ABAP program with an AI summary, build CDS views from plain English, and auto-repair broken ones."
• "Every change can be reviewed first, then pushed live to the package you choose."
